title: MCPTracer assert --spec --json output (v2)
description: Output of `mcptracer assert <session-id> --spec <spec.toml> --json`. v1 was a bare JSON array with no version marker; v2 wraps that same array of assertion results in an object carrying a required `schema_version` integer field, so a CI job pinned to a schema can detect the shape it received instead of guessing from content. The element shape is unchanged from v1. `assert --golden --json` emits diff-report.v3.schema.json instead, not this schema. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.
